myesb-rest-consumer.name: myesb-rest-consumer
myesb-rest-consumer.description: This Consumer can be used to receive REST requests over HTTP(s). It is a request-response Consumer so the result of the Services will be sent back if the flow is closed with a reply-Producer. The Consumer can handle RESTful calls.

kafka-consumer.description: This listener can be used to listen to Kafka topics.

myesb-ftp-consumer.name: myesb-ftp-consumer
myesb-ftp-consumer.description: An FTP Consumer can read files from a FTP server. This supports plain FTP and SFTP (FTP by SSH). The component copies the files from the remote directory to a local one while retaining the original file name. After that the file is being sent to the Services. Read files can be backed up in a predefined directory.

myesb-file-consumer.name: myesb-file-consumer
myesb-file-consumer.description: This Consumer is used to read files in a flow, from the file system. Read files can be backed up in a predefined back-up directory. Use a cron-expression to poll on certain times. Consumer can also detect if files are still being written to. The output is a ConnectMessage in which the content of the file is being copied into a so called MessagePart.
